claims.summary: The Project Management audit showed a caveated 97/100 package where the export card was amber but header and agent surfaces still implied clean readiness.
A shared package trust helper now returns clean/review/blocked/running/not-graded state from quality, receipt, source/genome caveats, and readiness evidence.
Workspace quality chip, export stamp, package summary, digest card, agent working set, progress header, and direct finish messages use the shared helper so green means clean.
